turns.question: Which channel's cost per booking rose the most from the week of 14 September 2026 to the week of 21 September, and by how many euros?
turns.answer: Social's cost per booking rose the most, from 98.00 EUR (week of 14 September) to 125.00 EUR (week of 21 September), an increase of 27.00 EUR; search fell by 3.13 EUR and email was unchanged. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
